hooks.command: sh -c 'for d in . "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" "$PWD"/*/*; do [ -f "$d/gauntlet/adapters/antigravity/agy_hooks.py" ] && cd "$d" && exec python3 -I -B gauntlet/adapters/antigravity/agy_hooks.py pre-tool --role hardener; done; printf "{\"decision\":\"allow\"}"'

Stop.command: sh -c 'for d in . "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" "$PWD"/*/*; do [ -f "$d/gauntlet/adapters/antigravity/agy_hooks.py" ] && cd "$d" && exec python3 -I -B gauntlet/adapters/antigravity/agy_hooks.py stop --agent hardener --task mutationGate --max-attempts 2 --timeout 3300; done; printf "{}"'
